userInput: Review the attached Harbor Stitch Apparel data source for 2025. Build a sophisticated four-panel audit dashboard covering monthly production, defect rates by production line, duplicate supplier payments and fabric efficiency. Use a white background with graphite labels, teal data and amber exceptions. Make the charts legible and carefully spaced, with direct annotations and useful comparisons. Show the exact SQL and explain the results behind each finding. Save a PNG, PDF, reproducible Python script and the executed SQL. Keep the final answer concise and embed the dashboard. These are fictional business records. Distinguish review indicators from proven fraud.
query:
SELECT s.supplier_name,
       i.supplier_reference,
       COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id)::int AS invoice_count,
       SUM(i.amount) AS invoiced_total,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.payment_id)::int AS payment_count,
       SUM(p.amount) AS paid_total
FROM public.supplier_invoices i
JOIN public.suppliers s ON s.supplier_id = i.supplier_id
LEFT JOIN public.supplier_payments p
  ON p.invoice_id = i.invoice_id
 AND p.payment_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND p.payment_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
WHERE i.invoice_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND i.invoice_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY s.supplier_name, i.supplier_reference
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_id) > 1
ORDER BY invoiced_total DESC, s.supplier_name, i.supplier_reference
LIMIT 100;
